entries.title: Philippians 4:1
segments: Therefore, my brothers, ones loved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand fast in this way in [the] Lord, beloved ones.

entries.title: Philippians 4:2
segments: I beg Euodia and Syntyche that they be of the same mind in [the] Lord.

entries.title: Philippians 4:3
segments: And I also beg you, true yoke-fellow, help those women who labored in the gospel with me and with Clement, and others of my fellow-laborers, whose names [are] in the Book of Life.

entries.title: Philippians 4:4
segments: Rejoice in [the] Lord always. Again I say, Rejoice!

entries.title: Philippians 4:5
segments: Let your moderation be known to all men. The Lord [is] at hand.

entries.title: Philippians 4:6
segments: Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

entries.title: Philippians 4:7
segments: And the peace of God which passes all understanding shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 4:8
segments: Finally, my brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things [are] honest, whatever [things are] right, whatever [things are] pure, whatever [things are] lovely, whatever [things are] of good report; if [ there is] any virtue and if [there is] any praise, think on these things.

entries.title: Philippians 4:9
segments: Do those things which you have also learned and received and heard and seen in me. And the God of peace shall be with you.

entries.title: Philippians 4:10
segments: But I rejoiced in [the] Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me has flourished again. Although you indeed did think, but you lacked opportunity.

entries.title: Philippians 4:11
segments: Not that I speak according to need, for I have learned to be content in whatever state I am.

entries.title: Philippians 4:12
segments: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound. In everything and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

entries.title: Philippians 4:13
segments: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

entries.title: Philippians 4:14
segments: Yet you did well in sharing my troubles.

entries.title: Philippians 4:15
segments: Now you Philippians know also that in [the] beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as regards giving and receiving, except you alone.

entries.title: Philippians 4:16
segments: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my necessity.

entries.title: Philippians 4:17
segments: I do not say this because I desire a gift, but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

entries.title: Philippians 4:18
segments: But I have all, and abound. I have been filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things [which you sent], an odor of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable and well-pleasing to God.

entries.title: Philippians 4:19
segments: But my God shall supply all your need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 4:20
segments: Now unto God and our Father [be] glory forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: Philippians 4:21
segments: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

entries.title: Philippians 4:22
segments: All the saints greet you, most of all those who are of Caesar's household.

entries.title: Philippians 4:23
segments: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with you all. Amen.
